evidence.notes: Typed String query with AccessLevel returns seeded Account rows.
Typed String and Map<String,Object> binds with AccessLevel return matching Account rows.
Typed String count query with AccessLevel returns the seeded row count.
Typed String count query and Map<String,Object> binds with AccessLevel return the matching count.
List<SObject> source produces an iterable QueryLocator over each source row.
List<SObject> source with AccessLevel produces an iterable QueryLocator.
Typed String query with AccessLevel produces an iterable QueryLocator.

source.content: Account hot = new Account(Name = 'Hot Account', Rating = 'Hot'); Account warm = new Account(Name = 'Warm Account', Rating = 'Warm'); insert new List<Account>{hot, warm}; List<Account> allRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, allRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Hot Account', allRows[0].Name); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('rating', 'Warm'); List<Account> warmRows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, warmRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Warm Account', warmRows[0].Name); System.assertEquals(2, Database.countQuery('SELECT Id FROM Account', AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); System.assertEquals(1, Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); List<SObject> sourceRows = new List<SObject>{hot, warm}; Database.QueryLocator listLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(sourceRows); Object listIterator = listLocator.iterator(); System.assert(listIterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Hot Account', ((Account)listIterator.next()).Name); System.assert(listIterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Warm Account', ((Account)listIterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!listIterator.hasNext()); List<SObject> accessRows = new List<SObject>{hot}; Database.QueryLocator accessListLocator = Database.getQueryLocator(accessRows, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); Object accessIterator = accessListLocator.iterator(); System.assert(accessIterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Hot Account', ((Account)accessIterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!accessIterator.hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator stringLocator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object stringIterator = stringLocator.iterator(); Integer stringCount = 0; while (stringIterator.hasNext()) { Account row = (Account)stringIterator.next(); System.assert(row.Name != null); stringCount++; } System.assertEquals(2, stringCount); Database.QueryLocator bindLocator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object bindIterator = bindLocator.iterator(); System.assert(bindIterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Warm Account', ((Account)bindIterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!bindIterator.hasNext());
